game.name: Lego Marvel Super Heroes (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Da,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: LEGO Marvel, Super Heroes features an original story crossing the entire Marvel Universe. Players take control of Iron Man, Spider-Man, the Hulk, Captain America, Wolverine and many more Marvel characters as they unite to stop Loki and a host of other Marvel villains from assembling a super-weapon capable of destroying the world.
